name: 20oz Tapered Stainless Steel Tumbler
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- 18/8 Stainless Steel: Made from high-quality, food-grade 304 stainless steel with a seamless design that is built to resist rust and puncture.

-BPA-Free Components: The airtight, clear lid is completely non-toxic and composed of food-grade materials.

- Rubber Gasket: Includes a reliable rubber gasket seal to prevent accidental splashes and keep your drinks securely contained.

Crafted for durability and safety, this tumbler is engineered with top-tier materials to ensure a pure, clean taste with every sip.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

The tapered shape offers an ergonomic hold while comfortably fitting into most standard vehicle cup holders.

- Height: 17 cm (~6.69 in)

- Top Diameter: 9 cm (~3.54in)

- Base Diameter: 7 cm (~2.76 in)

- Capacity: 20oz

 

  • Printing Technology:

- Printed using high-quality full-wrap UV printing for vibrant colors and detailed artwork.

- The high-resolution print technology delivers clean lines and sharp colors that wrap beautifully from the front to the back view.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

- Engineered with premium double-wall vacuum insulation to maintain your beverage's temperature for hours, no matter the weather.

- Thermal Retention: Keeps your hot beverages warm for up to 6+ hours and your cold drinks ice-cold for up to 12+ hours.

- Sweat-Free Exterior: The insulated barrier prevents condensation from forming on the outside, protecting your hands and keeping your cup surfaces completely dry.

- Easy-to-Sip Lid: Features a convenient leak-proof slider and a dual-purpose sip & straw hole to match your preferred drinking style.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

Whether you are celebrating a special friendship, honoring an inspiring mentor or educator, or customizing a gift for a loved one, this personalized tumbler is the ideal choice. Its combination of premium insulation, full-wrap customization, and everyday functionality creates a gift that is both stylish and useful.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 2-3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 5-7 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x20oz Tapered Stainless Steel Tumbler

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
